name: Indie Dev Tools

sources.title: Homepage — 'hand-curated collection of highly-useful tools for independent developers and solopreneurs'; 'Add your tool' nav button, /login link
Add-tool route — Vue SPA; unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login by the 'Add your tool' handler

requirements: Tools must be useful to independent developers / solopreneurs — on-form notice: 'Every added tool will be reviewed before being published. Please make sure the tool is helpful to the indie dev community!'
Account required: the Add-your-tool handler sends logged-out users to /login; registration at /register
Listings are manually reviewed before publication — no instant listing
preparation: Tool name and URL (placeholder format https://tool.com)
Short description and long description (separate form fields)
Logo image and a large/screenshot image (form has logo + largeImage uploads)
Tags (free-input tag field) and a category pick from ~15 categories (AI, Development, SEO, Marketing, Launch, etc.)
workflow: Click 'Add your tool' (goes to https://indiedev.tools/add-tool once authenticated)
Fill name, URL, short + long description, upload logo and large image, set tags and category
Submit; on success the site confirms 'Tool added successfully. It will be reviewed before being published.'
Track the listing under /my-tools and /edit-tool/:id once published
watchFor: Submissions can be temporarily closed — the form has an isSubmissionClosed state that hides the submit UI
Hand-curated directory: low-fit or low-quality tools likely rejected
Form is client-rendered (Vue) — needs JS; the /add-tool URL alone shows homepage content to logged-out crawlers
countsAsLive: The tool gets a public /tool/<slug> page on indiedev.tools and appears in category listings after review
unknowns: Whether outbound links are dofollow (cards use ?ref=indiedev.tools redirect-style links)
Any paid/feature options — none found in the submit flow
